I reviewed all eight comments and saved seven open items to your checklist. Monday’s punctuation fix in the dam example is already in the draft, so I checked that one off.

Dr. Lindqvist’s Wednesday update allows planning help but rules out AI suggestions for the final draft. The checklist uses revision questions. I put the non-identity objection first: if different choices would bring different people into existence, why do you think the duty still holds?

Monday’s Parfit citation suggestion is still pending. Check the page in your own copy and enter the number you verify. The paper is due Friday, March 12, at 11:59 p.m. Eastern.
